claim.quote: A search for a resonance in the $e^{+}e^{-}$ invariant mass distribution, using 1.7 days (1170 nb$^{-1}$) of data, showed no evidence of dark photon decays above the large QED background, confirming earlier searches and demonstrating the full functionality of the experiment.

name: HPS first dark-photon search (2015 engineering run)

summary.plain: HPS's first data, taken in a 2015 engineering run, showed no sign of a dark photon with mass between 19 and 81 MeV, setting limits on its coupling to ordinary photons at the level of 6 x 10^-6 and showing the whole experiment worked.
summary.technical: Resonance search in the e+e- invariant-mass distribution with 1.7 days (1170 nb^-1) of 2015 engineering-run data: no evidence of dark-photon decays above the large QED background for masses 19-81 MeV/c^2; upper limits on the squared coupling of about 6e-6.

title: Search for a Dark Photon in Electro-Produced e+e- Pairs with the Heavy Photon Search Experiment at JLab
why_it_matters: Showed that the HPS technique works and confirmed earlier prompt-resonance searches ahead of its high-luminosity runs.
